kpi.tooltip.mrr: Monthly recurring revenue from active subscription plan pricing.
kpi.tooltip.arr: Annual recurring revenue calculated as MRR multiplied by twelve.
kpi.tooltip.active_subscriptions: Distinct active subscribers at the end of the selected period.
kpi.tooltip.platform_sales: Anonymous combined POS revenue across tenant shops.
kpi.tooltip.operating_cash_flow: Aggregate cash inflows minus cash outflows.
kpi.tooltip.active_customers: Distinct tenant customer records with activity in the selected period, shown only as a count.
kpi.tooltip.open_tickets: Open platform support tickets. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.low_stock_alerts: Anonymous count of products at or below alert threshold. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.company_health_score: Weighted score combining subscription growth, cash flow, churn, support risk, and inventory risk.
kpi.tooltip.total_sales: Combined sales revenue across all tenant shops without tenant or product details.
kpi.tooltip.conversion_funnel: Anonymous conversion proxy based on active customer and order counts.
kpi.tooltip.repeat_purchase_rate: Share of customers with more than one purchase in the selected period.
kpi.tooltip.average_order_value: Total sales divided by order count.
kpi.tooltip.cac: Customer acquisition cost from the marketing abstraction layer.
kpi.tooltip.roas: Return on ad spend from the marketing abstraction layer.
kpi.tooltip.traffic_sources: Total attributed traffic sessions from the marketing abstraction layer.
kpi.tooltip.lead_conversion_rate: Share of leads that converted in the fallback marketing dataset.
kpi.tooltip.total_headcount: Aggregate employee count across tenant operational records.
kpi.tooltip.turnover_rate: Fallback HR turnover indicator. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.process_throughput: Fallback count of completed operational units.
kpi.tooltip.cycle_time: Fallback average process cycle time. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.downtime: Fallback downtime minutes. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.gross_profit_margin: Gross profit divided by sales revenue.
kpi.tooltip.net_profit_margin: Gross profit minus expenses divided by sales revenue.
kpi.tooltip.accounts_receivable: Aggregate positive customer balances. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.accounts_payable: Aggregate supplier balances. Lower is better.
kpi.tooltip.cash_flow_trend: Net cash movement across the selected period.
kpi.tooltip.inventory_turnover_rate: Units sold divided by average inventory quantity.
kpi.tooltip.stockout_alerts: Anonymous count of products with zero or negative quantity.
kpi.tooltip.warehouse_capacity_usage: Estimated capacity usage based on aggregate inventory quantity.
kpi.tooltip.csat_score: Proxy score inferred from support closure and open-ticket pressure.
kpi.tooltip.first_response_time: Average time between ticket creation and first recorded admin update.
kpi.tooltip.ticket_volume: Tickets opened during the selected period. Lower is better when demand is stable.
kpi.tooltip.support_sla_tracking: Tickets answered or closed within the support SLA window.
kpi.tooltip.dau_mau_ratio: Daily active tenants divided by monthly active tenants.
kpi.tooltip.trial_to_paid_conversion: New paid subscriptions divided by new shop-owner signups.
kpi.tooltip.ltv_to_cac_ratio: Estimated lifetime value divided by acquisition cost.
kpi.tooltip.churn_rate: Expired or canceled subscriptions divided by active subscription base.
kpi.tooltip.gmv: Gross merchandise value from anonymous tenant sales.
kpi.tooltip.cart_abandonment_rate: Proxy based on partial and unpaid sales against total checkout activity.
kpi.tooltip.refund_rate: Sales marked with returns divided by total sales.
kpi.description.mrr: MRR is the normalized monthly recurring revenue from active paid subscriptions.
kpi.description.arr: ARR is recurring revenue annualized from the current MRR baseline.
kpi.description.churn_rate: Churn rate shows the percentage of subscriptions that expired or were canceled in the selected period.
kpi.description.active_subscriptions: Active subscriptions counts distinct subscribers with an active subscription at the end of the selected period.

kpi.section.data_privacy.item_no_product: Customer names and product-level inventory details are not shown.

kpi.definition.overview.heading: Executive meaning
kpi.definition.overview.description: How to read the company-level health view.
kpi.definition.overview.item_1: Meaning: the overview summarizes subscription, cash, support, and tenant activity health.
kpi.definition.overview.item_2: Calculation: weighted platform aggregates from real SaaS, sales, cash, support, and inventory tables.
kpi.definition.overview.item_3: Business use: prioritize executive attention without exposing tenant records.
kpi.definition.overview.item_4: Security: drill-down data stays anonymous on KPI dashboards.
kpi.definition.sales.heading: Sales meaning
kpi.definition.sales.description: Revenue productivity across anonymous tenant sales.
kpi.definition.sales.item_1: Meaning: sales KPIs measure aggregate commercial momentum.
kpi.definition.sales.item_2: Calculation: non-voided sales totals, order counts, repeat purchase rate, and AOV.
kpi.definition.sales.item_3: Business use: detect demand changes and purchase-quality changes.
kpi.definition.sales.item_4: Security: no shop, customer, invoice, or product details are displayed.
kpi.definition.marketing.heading: Marketing meaning
kpi.definition.marketing.item_1: Meaning: CAC and ROAS show whether growth spend is efficient.
kpi.definition.marketing.item_2: Calculation: structured fallback until ad and attribution endpoints are connected.
kpi.definition.marketing.item_3: Business use: guide budget allocation and channel focus.
kpi.definition.marketing.item_4: Security: no campaign audience records are stored in the UI.
kpi.definition.hr.heading: HR meaning
kpi.definition.hr.item_1: Meaning: HR KPIs show whether teams can sustain platform operations.
kpi.definition.hr.item_2: Calculation: real headcount plus fallback readiness indicators.
kpi.definition.hr.item_3: Business use: plan hiring, training, and retention actions.
kpi.definition.hr.item_4: Security: employee names and tenant staffing records are not listed.
kpi.definition.operations.heading: Operations meaning
kpi.definition.operations.item_1: Meaning: operations KPIs show whether work is flowing reliably.
kpi.definition.operations.item_2: Calculation: structured fallback until monitoring telemetry is connected.
kpi.definition.operations.item_3: Business use: identify bottlenecks and SLA risk.
kpi.definition.operations.item_4: Security: no individual workflow records are exposed.
kpi.definition.finance.heading: Finance meaning
kpi.definition.finance.item_1: Meaning: finance KPIs show margin quality and liquidity pressure.
kpi.definition.finance.item_2: Calculation: aggregate sales, gross profit, expenses, balances, and cash transactions.
kpi.definition.finance.item_3: Business use: protect cash runway and margin quality.
kpi.definition.finance.item_4: Security: no customer or supplier names are displayed.
kpi.definition.supply_chain.heading: Supply chain meaning
kpi.definition.supply_chain.item_1: Meaning: supply chain KPIs reveal stock movement and availability risk.
kpi.definition.supply_chain.item_2: Calculation: aggregate inventory movements and anonymous product counts.
kpi.definition.supply_chain.item_3: Business use: prevent stockouts and excess capacity usage.
kpi.definition.supply_chain.item_4: Security: product names, barcodes, and shop inventory details are not shown.
kpi.definition.customer_service.heading: Customer service meaning
kpi.definition.customer_service.item_1: Meaning: support KPIs show ticket pressure and responsiveness.
kpi.definition.customer_service.item_2: Calculation: support ticket status, response-time proxy, and SLA closure rates.
kpi.definition.customer_service.item_3: Business use: protect retention and renewal confidence.
kpi.definition.customer_service.item_4: Security: ticket subjects, messages, and tenant identities are not shown.
kpi.definition.saas.heading: SaaS meaning
kpi.definition.saas.item_1: Meaning: SaaS KPIs show retention, activation, recurring revenue, and monetization quality.
kpi.definition.saas.item_2: Calculation: subscription status, plan pricing, user activity timestamps, and acquisition fallback cost.
kpi.definition.saas.item_3: Business use: improve onboarding, pricing, and retention strategy.
kpi.definition.saas.item_4: Security: subscriber identities are not displayed.
kpi.definition.ecommerce.heading: E-commerce meaning
kpi.definition.ecommerce.description: Marketplace-style sales quality across tenant shops.
kpi.definition.ecommerce.item_1: Meaning: e-commerce KPIs show GMV, refunds, abandonment proxy, and anonymous category demand.
kpi.definition.ecommerce.item_2: Calculation: non-voided sales, return flags, partial/unpaid sale status, and anonymous category segments.
kpi.definition.ecommerce.item_3: Business use: understand purchase health without tenant-level exposure.
kpi.definition.ecommerce.item_4: Security: product names and tenant category names are anonymized.
